Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Punchline: MIDI Editor, Bard Workbench, native ensembles, and concert capture.
Description: Windbound Bard MIDI suite with a full piano roll, MIDI event editing, hardware input and output, and local SoundFont audition. Includes same-PC ensemble song sharing, a low-render camera for background followers, MIDI Workbench, Soulweaver Studio, Showmaster, the native Performance HUD toggle, and MP4 concert capture.
Changelog: Added an opt-in low-render follower camera under BAND → Ensemble. It aims the camera at the ground and narrows the view while a follower performs in the background. Focusing the follower window or leaving Performance restores the normal view.
